[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-iq[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]⌘↵ opens a highlight's page in Highlights[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]In Obsidian, ⌘↵ on a reference-note highlight, a 🔖 bookmark line, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]or a Task Link to an annotation task opens the exact PDF in [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Highlights and lands on that highlight's page. A status-bar chip [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and a highlighter rail show beforehand what ⌘↵ will do, on reading [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]tasks too. One Bob toast announces each press before Highlights [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]takes focus.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202611/highlights_annotation_page_jump.md[/#87AFFF]

[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-iq/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Hammerspoon page-jump URL handler[/bold #D7AFFF]                             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]hs_page_url[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]hs_page_url: in chezmoi, bind hammerspoon://bob-highlights-page. It [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]waits for the exact PDF to settle in front, jumps through the existing [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]page runner with ⌃O history, re-checks the landing, and reports the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]result inside Highlights. Includes busted specs and README.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Pure annotation locator[/bold #D7AFFF]                                       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]locator[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]locator: in bob-plugins, a pure fragment that maps a ref-note line to [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]its managed ^h- block. It returns the block kind, the 1-based page [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](caption or piece), a snippet, and the rail range. It also parses 🔖 [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]links and the archive PDF wikilink. Tested against golden fixtures [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]copied from bob-cli.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Resolver, exact-path launch, and page request[/bold #D7AFFF]                 [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]open_at_page[dim] · [dim][/dim]after locator, hs_page_url[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]open_at_page: extend the ⌘↵ command so that one resolver handles reading[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tasks, 🔖 lines, Task Links, and managed blocks. It follows hops, stubs,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and the unique-ID fallback, and opens ref_history archives through their[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]annotated_pdf. It opens the exact path, then sends the Hammerspoon page [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]request. Adds a dry mode, an announce seam with plain notices, a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]re-entry lock, and the additive api page option.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The Highlights toast card[/bold #D7AFFF]                                     [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]toast[dim] · [dim][/dim]after open_at_page[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]toast: replace the plain announce notices with one rich .bob-nh-notice [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Highlights card in highlighter ink. It shows a page receipt, the title, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and a quote snippet, appears before dispatch, and updates in place on [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]failure.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Availability chip, rail, and 📖 tooltip[/bold #D7AFFF]                       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]hints[dim] · [dim][/dim]after toast[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]hints: a status-bar chip and a line rail, both driven by the dry [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]resolver, show what ⌘↵ will open. Adds a session toggle and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]ledger-tools 📖 tooltip mention. Tests that the hint always matches what[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the key does.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob-cli client contract docs and decision record[/bold #D7AFFF]              [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]contract_docs[dim] · [dim][/dim]after open_at_page, hs_page_url[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]contract_docs: declare the generated captions, piece metadata, and block[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]shapes as a client contract in bob-cli docs. Extend the ⌘↵ sentence in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]docs/ref.md and record the Hammerspoon page-jump decision.[/#D7D7AF]
